name: Haya Harareet
biography: Haya Harareet (born Haya Neuberg; September 20, 1931 - February 3, 2021) was an Israeli actress and screenwriter best known for her role in Ben-Hur (1959), and was the last surviving credited cast member of the classic.
movies: The Doll that Took the Town
